name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park — Near Knott's) Medianoche Roasted Pork, Ham & Swiss on Sweet Egg Bread or Turkey Sandwich
brandOrRestaurant: Porto's Bakery & Cafe (Beach Blvd, Buena Park · Steps from Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Porto's **Medianoche** uses pillowy-soft, crustless-style sweet egg brioche bread pressed warm with slow-roasted pork, ham, and naturally lactose-safe Swiss cheese (or order their Roasted Turkey Breast Sandwich or Morning Egg-Ham-Swiss Croissant)— paired with sweet fried plantains (maduros) or banana chips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Medianoche** or **Pan con Lechon** with **NO pickles** and **NO mustard/onions**, or the **Slow-Roasted Turkey Sandwich**, paired with sweet plantains (maduros).
watchOuts: Ask to hold pickles and raw onions on sandwiches; skip the black bean soup
